    *   Blocking unrelated models like `solar-pro3`.

804	            tool_bindings: list[Any] = Field(default_factory=list)

807	            def bind_tools(
808	                self,
809	                tools: Sequence[dict[str, Any] | type[BaseModel] | Callable[..., Any] | BaseTool],
810	                **kwargs: Any,

812	                # Record every tool binding event.
